Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade one

Strand: Social Environment
Topic 1.4: Our School ● Main physical features ● Safety

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Our School ● Main physical features ● Safety, part of Social Environment in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade one ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How do you identify your way to school? 2. How can you be safe while coming to school?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Our School ● Main physical features ● Safety together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Unity: learner enriches cooperation and team spirit when role playing safety measures to take on the way to school.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Socio economic Issues: learner acquires child road safety awareness when role playing safety measures to take on the way to school and back.

Link to other learning areas:

Drawing Physical features between home and school can be used to develop the skill of drawing and colouring in Creative Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources

Digital devices with assistive technology, school environment, home environment, crayons, pencils, pictures, manilla papers, tactile sketch

maps, approved support learning materials (textbooks)
